newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti analyst meetings next week off.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti analyst meetings next week off.

text.p: Meetings between Olivetti and financial analysts planned for next week in Milan and London have been postponed until after publication of the group's full half-yearly report, an Olivetti source said.

An Olivetti statement earlier on Friday said that to supply comprehensive information it decided to meet the financial community "in conjunction with the publication of the Olivetti's full six monthly results, which is scheduled for September 30."

Clarifying the statement, the source said Olivetti senior management wants to meet with analysts and shareholders both in Milan and London once the full accounts report has been issued and they have had a chance to study it.
"Both meetings with foreign and Italian analysts and investors next week will be postponed until after September 30. There will be no meetings next week," the source said.
Under Italian law, September 30 is the deadline for the publication of a company's half-yearly report.

Olivetti has set that date for publication to give the company time to complete the extra work involved in providing Italian stock market regulator Consob with the further details it has asked for on the six-monthly balance sheet, and to comply with its latest request for details of Olivetti's financial position up to the end of August this year.
